# video-evidence

A **shared GitHub Pages player** for PR *video* evidence across juspay
projects. Clips live on each project's own repo; this repo is just the player.

## Why this exists

GitHub PR comments only auto-embed a video *player* for files uploaded through
the web composer (a `user-attachments` URL a human drags in). An agent driving
`gh` can't mint one, and a `<video>` tag in a comment is stripped by the
markdown sanitizer. So a committed/release-hosted `.mp4` renders as a download
link, not a player. This repo is the workaround:

- **Clips** stay on each project's **own** `evidence-assets` release (e.g.
  kolu's clips on `juspay/kolu`) — uploaded with `gh release upload`, the same
  mechanism projects already use for screenshot evidence. No repo bloat (release
  assets, not git blobs), and nothing project-specific to host here.
- **`evidence.html`** is a static player served by GitHub Pages. Given
  `?repo=<owner/repo>&v=<filename>`, it renders that repo's release asset in a
  real `<video>` element — audio, seeking, full resolution.

## Usage

```
https://juspay.github.io/video-evidence/evidence.html?repo=juspay/kolu&v=clip.mp4
```

A PR comment embeds an inline GIF for the at-a-glance proof and links here for
the HD/audio version.

## Safety

`repo` is constrained to the `juspay/<name>` org (regex `^juspay/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`)
and `v` to `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, so the player can only ever load files from our own
org's releases — never an arbitrary cross-origin URL.
